$comment: Bundle size budgets, checked by `yarn size` (scripts/check-size.mjs) on what `yarn build` writes to dist/.
Sizes are gzip at level 9, in kB of 1000 bytes; a group of files is the sum of each file's size, as each one is sent apart.
«measured» is the size when the budget was set; the budget is that plus about 5 %, rounded up (to 0.1 kB under 100 kB, to 1 kB above).
Raising a budget needs a reason in the commit message: see docs/testing.md.

initialJs.what: The JavaScript the editor's index.html loads at start: its module script and every module it preloads. What a first visit waits for, with the texts of one language (see «languages»); React is about 68 kB of it.

*.what: Each language's texts (src/copy/<language>.ts), a chunk of its own: index.html preloads only the one it shows, so what a first visit waits for is «initialJs» plus one of these. Set on the largest, French.

hi.what: Hindi's texts: Devanagari takes three bytes a letter in UTF-8, so the same texts weigh more than in the other languages. Its font (about 121 kB of woff2, the Devanagari subset of Noto Sans Devanagari) isn't JavaScript and loads only with them.

totalJs.what: Every .js and .mjs file of the build: the editor's lazy chunks (dialogs, crop mode, each language's texts, of which only one loads), pdf.js and its worker (about 500 kB), pdf-lib (about 180 kB), the contour worker and the static pages' scripts. Catches a dependency that grows or gets in by accident.

css.what: Every .css file of the build: the editor's stylesheet, which blocks its first paint, and Hindi's font rule (devanagari-*.css, about 0.25 kB, loaded only with Hindi). The static pages carry their CSS inline (counted in each page).

pageScripts.what: The scripts the static pages load, built apart from the editor: today only the calculator (cuantas-fotos-caben-en-una-hoja). Grows a lot if it ever pulls in editor code.

*.what: Each static page (every .html of the build but the editor's index.html), its HTML with its inline CSS; it applies to new pages too. Set on the largest one, cuantas-fotos-caben-en-una-hoja; the other guides are 5.3 to 5.8 kB and the legal pages 5.7 to 6.4 kB.

es/privacidad.html.what: The privacy policy, from docs/legal/privacidad.md: it lists every key the app stores in the browser, so it grows with each new setting.

es/licencias-de-terceros.html.what: The third-party licenses page, from THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: it grows with each dependency the build ships.
